RE-RUN with the BREAST-NATIVE wavelet prior fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt (out_scale=0.5, n_train=3600, val_flow_loss 0.0031) -- the FAIR test replacing the earlier Mayo-prior fallback (out_scale 0.05, 10x mu mismatch, all 20 iters hr=0). DC ON (constrained): fd_recon_dc=1 enables the hard CG data-consistency projection each Euler step (dc_relax=0.5, n_cg=5) -- this is what makes constrained genuine (a real min||Ax-y||^2 CG solve onto the measured 128-view sinogram), vs the unconstrained sibling which sets dc=0. (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline -- canonical fast_recon constrained defaults (8-step Euler, FBP init t=0.7, eta=1.0, DC on CG=5 relax=0.5). FALSIFIER: if hr=0 still, the sparse-view wavelet prior is over-smoothing/mis-aligned -> iters raise dc_relax toward 1.0 and lower init_t (less prior drift). (5) BUDGET: 200 slices x 8-step Euler + 5-iter CG, breast single shared PYRO-NN projector, 512^2 -- well inside HARD 20-min (30-min sbatch wall). val = ALL 200 fixed seed-20260703 val cases. (6) Loop continues; iter-2 self-dispatched on landing. Reserved levers iters 2-20: fd_recon_dc_relax, fd_recon_init_t, fd_recon_steps, fd_recon_eta, fd_recon_dc_n_cg.
